steps: Go to https://www.bmo.com/en-us/main/personal/checking-accounts/digital-offer/ and confirm you are a resident of one of the 14 listed states.

Between September 9, 2026 and December 15, 2026, open a new BMO Smart Money, Smart Advantage, or Relationship Checking account — online via 'OPEN IN MINUTES' (promo code auto-applied) or in-branch/phone via 'SEND MY PROMO CODE'.
Fund the account (minimum $25 opening deposit required).

Beginning the month after account opening, have a cumulative total of $1,000 or more in qualifying direct deposits (employer/ACH salary, pension, Social Security; NOT Zelle, Venmo, wires, or bank transfers) post each month.
Each qualifying month, a $100 cash bonus is paid to the account approximately 10 days after the beginning of the next month, for up to 6 months.
NOTE: the current official offer is up to $600, not the route's claimed $400 — treat the $400 figure as stale and do not rely on it.
timing: Each $100 monthly bonus is paid approximately 10 days after the beginning of the next month (e.g. December qualifying deposits pay in January). Up to 6 consecutive months; the account must be open, in good standing, and have a balance greater than zero when each bonus is paid.
